verdict.rationale: SigNoz ships a first-party MCP server and Agent Skills that let AI agents query metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards in natural language, generate queries (including ClickHouse queries), and create dashboards from natural-language requests. This covers both halves of the story: a real query and a chart/dashboard. However, the experience runs through an external AI client such as Claude or Cursor rather than an evidenced in-app assistant. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-product natural-language query assistant, in-depth docs showing the returned query/chart output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Query metrics, traces, logs, alerts, and dashboards through natural language.
generate queries over traces, logs, and metrics, write ClickHouse queries, create and modify dashboards
Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
